title: Design System: Fahad Sajad — Video Editor Portfolio

label.purpose: Mono functional labels — frame numbers, spec codes, nav tabs. Floor: 0.7rem.

shadows.name: light-bar-indicator
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system — a real offset cast shadow under the scroll-position light-bar window.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA — transparent at rest, fills solid ink with paper text on hover/focus.
components.html: Review the Full Sheet
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0.95rem 1.6rem; border: 1.5px solid #1c1911; border-radius: 99px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1c1911; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #1c1911; color: #ece5d3; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: A contact-sheet frame — grayscale thumbnail that reveals color on hover, real frame number, SVG play badge.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ece5d3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card__frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; width: 100%; background: #1b1914; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card__bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-size: cover; background-position: center; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05); transition: filter 0.6s, transform 0.7s; } .ds-card__frame:hover .ds-card__bg { filter: grayscale(0) contrast(1.05); transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-card__fnum { position: absolute; left: 0.6rem; top: 0.6rem; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #ece5d3; } .ds-card__play { position: absolute; right: 0.7rem; bottom: 0.7rem; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(236,229,211,.55); color: #ece5d3; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-card__play svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; } .ds-card__frame:hover .ds-card__play { opacity: 1; background: #7a2c07; border-color: #7a2c07; } .ds-card__info { padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1.3rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(28,25,17,.16); } .ds-card__info h3 { font-family: 'Alegreya', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; } .ds-card__info p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #56503e; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: A spine-index nav link, prefixed by its real frame number, underline grows on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #56503e; display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.4rem; position: relative; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-tab::before { content: attr(data-frame); color: #a83c09; } .ds-nav-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -5px; left: 0; height: 1px; width: 0; background: #1c1911; transition: width 0.3s; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: #1c1911; } .ds-nav-tab:hover::after, .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a working contact sheet reviewed on a light table, not a cinematic-viewer skin. Every section is a numbered "sheet" in a proof book: frame numbers, spec codes, and a grease-pencil review mark carry real information the way they would on an editor's actual proof sheet, not as decoration borrowed from the genre. The system explicitly rejects the video-editor-portfolio default (REC dot, running timecode, film grain, tally-light red on black) that the incumbent design used before this redesign — that look is the confirmed visual anti-reference.

The palette stays warm and paper-toned at rest; the single grease-orange accent is rare and functional; the display type is an italic serif with real editorial character rather than a system sans or an overused "safe" display face. Depth is expressed through material contrast (paper vs. near-black frame-void) rather than shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Warm light-table paper as the constant ground, never pure white or pure black
One accent color, used only where it marks something real (a link, an active state, a position indicator)
Italic serif display type carries the personality; mono type carries data
Frame/sheet numbering is real information architecture, not a decorative device
Flat at rest; shadows only appear as a response to interaction

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: The grease-orange accent appears only where it marks something real — an active link, a hover state, a position indicator. It never fills a large decorative area and never appears twice in the same place for emphasis alone.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in the system carries the same warm, slightly brown-green undertone — never a cool or pure gray.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional mono label renders below 0.7rem (11.2px). 22 instances were found below this floor and fixed during the finish review — never reintroduce a sub-11px label size.

rules.name: The Italic-Only Headline Rule
rules.body: Every h2/h1 in the display role renders italic. An upright display heading is off-system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow in the system belongs to the light-bar indicator, and it always carries a real offset — never a symmetrical glow.

dos: Do keep the grease accent (#a83c09) rare — active states, links, the light-bar indicator, the current nav tab. Nothing else.
Do keep every functional label at or above 0.7rem (11.2px).
Do vary each new section's opening composition rather than repeating the same kicker-then-heading template.
Do keep the work grid's card count a multiple of its column count (4 desktop / 2 tablet) so the last row never leaves a trailing empty void.
Do use real SVG line icons (stroke="currentColor", stroke-width: 1.5) for any icon.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. The system is built around exactly one.
Don't use a symmetrical/zero-offset shadow anywhere — every shadow needs a real vertical offset.
Don't use a Unicode glyph or emoji as an icon — draw it as an SVG matching the existing stroke weight.
Don't set a display heading upright (non-italic) — italic is load-bearing to the system's voice.
Don't reintroduce timecode, REC-dot, film-grain, or scrubber-as-video-player motifs — that is the explicitly rejected prior world.
